company.name: Setpoint.io
company.shortDescription: Setpoint.io develops a platform purpose-built for the future of asset-backed lending.
company.description: Setpoint is building trust in our credit system. An operating system for capital markets functions that drives capital and operational efficiency, while offering peace-of-mind to Capital Providers. Our platform unlocks speed, efficiency and accuracy for borrowers and lenders.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that integrates with borrowers and lenders to manage debt facilities, automate borrowing base calculations, and ensure compliance across asset-backed lending portfolios.
productsAndServices.name: Capital Markets Operating System (Capital OS)

productsAndServices.description: Tech-enabled services that provide verification and certification of collateral documents and funding requests to support asset-backed lending transactions.
productsAndServices.name: Third-Party Due Diligence Services

productsAndServices.description: A tool within the Capital OS platform for real-time monitoring, forecasting, and optimization of capital usage and compliance across lending portfolios.
productsAndServices.name: Portfolio Manager

productsAndServices.description: A system to track data, documents, lender requirements, and operational workflows throughout the lifecycle of asset-backed loans.
productsAndServices.name: Collateral Manager

productsAndServices.description: An automated tool for managing Broker Price Opinions (BPO), appraisals, and Automated Valuation Models (AVM) to support asset valuation in lending transactions.
productsAndServices.name: Valuations Manager

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $31,000,000, or 38.99% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $37,403,531 to $349,260,635, a 9.34x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 87 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
